description: List this tenant's end users with last-seen and call counts, newest last-seen first. Optional since (unix seconds, filters last_seen), revoked (bool), limit (default 50, max 1000), and cursor (from a previous page's cursor field).

cursor.description: Opaque; resume after a previous response's cursor.

revoked.description: true: only revoked end users; false: only active ones; omit for both.

since.description: Only end users last seen at or after this unix timestamp.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Required only when this connection carries no Authorization: Bearer header -- when both are present, the header wins.

name: host.enduser.list
